stories.title: Flintshire Council to pay Coleg Cambria’s costs after losing Connah’s Quay pitch appeal
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has been ordered to pay Coleg Cambria’s full appeal costs after councillors refused plans for an all-weather football pitch against the advice of their own officers. stories.title: Toyota says Deeside is its first carbon-neutral plant outside Japan
stories.summary: Toyota’s engine plant in Deeside has started running on gas and electricity from a neighbouring waste plant, in what the company says is the start of carbon-neutral production. stories.title: Senedd rejects Reform bid to scrap default 20mph limit
stories.summary: The Senedd has rejected a Reform UK motion calling on the Welsh Government to scrap the default 20mph speed limit, by 51 votes to 37. stories.title: Free Slim Chickens every week for life up for grabs at new Broughton drive-thru
stories.summary: One customer at a new Broughton drive-thru will win a free Slim Chickens meal every week for life when the restaurant opens next Tuesday. stories.title: Vaping liquid now taxed at £2.20 per 10ml as new UK duty starts
stories.summary: Vaping liquid is now taxed at £2.20 for every 10ml, under a new duty that came into force across the UK today. The Vaping Products Duty applies to all vaping liquids made in or imported into the UK from Thursday 1 October, whether or not they contain nicotine.
